plot: After World War II, in the devastated, rural Bosnia and Herzegovina, entrepreneur Emerik Blum created a large and successful company "Energoinvest" that operated worldwide with billions of dollars in profit. Taking advantage of the specific position of Yugoslavia, which did not belong to either the Eastern or Western political blocs, the company - relying on socialism and capitalism - operated according to a unique business model based on worker participation in management and profit.
